summaries.en: This curated guide serves as a comprehensive resource for anyone diving into generative AI, from research updates to interview prep. It organizes key papers, tutorials, and notebooks across LLMs, vision-language models, and more, making it easy to track the field's rapid evolution. The repository's strength lies in its structured, up-to-date collection, ideal for self-learners or educators building course materials. Use it to quickly find state-of-the-art references, practice with Jupyter notebooks, or prepare for technical interviews.

summary_short.zh: Palmier Pro 是一款专为 macOS 设计的 AI 原生视频编辑器，通过本地运行的 AI 模型（如 Claude 和 Seedance2）实现场景检测、语音转文字、自动剪辑等功能，所有数据在设备端处理，保障隐私安全。技术上采用 Swift 原生开发确保高性能，并支持 MCP 协议扩展 AI 能力。用户可根据转录文本快速生成粗剪，或一键应用 AI 特效，显著提升播客视频、教程录制等后期制作效率。

summaries.en: Palmier Pro is a macOS video editor designed to integrate AI directly into the editing workflow, solving the problem of manual, time-consuming video production. Its core strength lies in leveraging local AI models like Claude and Seedance2 for tasks such as scene detection, transcription, and automated editing, all while keeping data private on-device. You can use it to quickly generate rough cuts from transcripts or apply AI-powered effects, making it ideal for content creators who want to speed up post-production without leaving the desktop.

summary_short.zh: Agent-Native 是一个基于 TypeScript 的框架，旨在将 AI 智能体作为应用的一等公民，解决在 React 应用中集成大语言模型时面临的交互结构化与可控性难题。其核心设计理念是将智能体行为抽象为可组合的声明式层，类似 React 组件，开发者可以像搭建 UI 一样定义工具、记忆和推理流程，无需处理底层编排细节。你可以用它快速构建聊天机器人、自主工作流或 AI 副驾驶等原型，并通过自定义 React 组件实现 UI 驱动的智能体控制，让前端开发者也能轻松驾驭 AI 逻辑。

summaries.zh: Agent-Native 是一个基于 TypeScript 的框架，旨在将 AI 智能体作为应用的一等公民，解决在 React 应用中集成大语言模型时面临的交互结构化与可控性难题。其核心设计理念是将智能体行为抽象为可组合的声明式层，类似 React 组件，开发者可以像搭建 UI 一样定义工具、记忆和推理流程，无需处理底层编排细节。你可以用它快速构建聊天机器人、自主工作流或 AI 副驾驶等原型，并通过自定义 React 组件实现 UI 驱动的智能体控制，让前端开发者也能轻松驾驭 AI 逻辑。
summaries.en: Agent-Native is a TypeScript framework for building applications where AI agents are first-class citizens, solving the challenge of integrating LLMs into React apps with structured, controllable interactions. Its key insight is treating agent behavior as a composable, declarative layer—similar to React components—enabling developers to define tools, memory, and reasoning flows without boilerplate. You can use it to quickly prototype AI-powered features like chatbots, autonomous workflows, or copilots, and extend it with custom React components for UI-driven agent control.
